step_patterns.identity_hint: 0 application forms; mailto anchor or 'apply'+'@' text in the same paragraph

step_patterns.note: Sending the email is the irreversible action; in prepare-only mode the runtime may draft subject/body/attachments for human review only.

blockers.detail: No web form to fill; application happens over email, outside the browser executor.
blockers.human_action_needed: Human reviews and sends the drafted email with the resume attached.

runtime_observations: Detect this backend from the rendered page, not the URL: zero application forms plus an apply-intent paragraph containing an email address.
Prefer the mailto ?subject= preset when present; MassConvert presets differ per role.
Two of five pages contain a second, generic mailbox (howdy@/hello@/info@); the application address is the one inside the apply paragraph or the APPLY anchor, not the footer contact.
Healthcare Success names an individual recruiter mailbox; treat as the application address but do not scrape any other personal data.

inferred.body_shape_unverified: Short cover-letter body (3-6 paragraphs), resume as PDF attachment, subject '<Role> application' when no preset; UNVERIFIED preference of these employers.

provider_hint.for_jev: email backend: there is no form. Extract {to, subject, required attachments, narrative prompt} from the apply paragraph/mailto. Route the narrative prompt to the writer with the exact prompt text and job context. Output a draft for human review; never send.
exact_copy_facts: candidate name/email as sender (from verified facts only)
escalate_to_writer_opus: cover letter / note answering the page's narrative prompt (see field_patterns.cover_letter_or_note.prompts)

edge_cases: Brandog's address is plain text, not a mailto, so anchor-only scanners miss it.
Evron's careers page hosts multiple roles; the mailto subject disambiguates the role.
MassConvert's Facebook Ads role asks for 'one paragraph' (length constraint) while the DMM role asks for a 'short note' with three specific points.
